So the group of women from [[Bani Sa'd|بني سعد]], they come into [[Makkah|مكة]], and each one of them, they find parents who want to give their son to be brought up in the desert, and many of the women, they go back with a boy.
But as for [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, his mother was trying to find someone who would take him as well, but everybody refused.
Everybody refused to take [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ.
And this was because he didn't have a father.
So they thought to themselves, you know, when we bring these boys back, the father is the one who gives us the money.
This boy doesn't have a father, so what are we going to get for taking care of him?
Yeah, his grandfather is there, his mother is there, but they are not going to be able to take care of us as if his father was alive.
So they were afraid to take him because they thought that they wouldn't get anything out of it.
So [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ was left, and the women, they went back into the deserts with other boys who were born around the same time.
Now [[Halimah|حليمة]], she came into [[Makkah|مكة]] as well.
But she came a little bit later than the rest of the of the women from [[Bani Sa'd|بني سعد]].
And that was because, as we mentioned, she was very poor, and the donkey that she had that she used for transportation, it was an old, and it was a weak, and very slow donkey.
So she came later than the rest of them.
And when she came, at first she didn't take [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ either.
And they didn't find anyone else; [[Halimah|حليمة]] and her husband, they didn't find any other boy to take.
So they were leaving [[Makkah|مكة]].
And when they were on the outskirts of [[Makkah|مكة]], [[Halimah|حليمة]] said to her husband [[al-Harith|الحارث]],
she said to him, all of the other women, they took boys, but we came into [[Makkah|مكة]], now we're going to go back without anything.
You know what? I think we should go back into [[Makkah|مكة]], and we should take that boy, we should take that orphan boy.
And perhaps Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] will give us some [[barakah|بركة]], perhaps there will be some blessing in taking him.
him, and we will be taken care of as well. Let's just go, and let's take him.
So she made this decision which turned out to be the best and smartest decision in her life.
And they went back, and they took [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, and they took him back into the desert.
Now, the signs of the greatness of this baby were immediately visible.
Like we mentioned, when [[Halimah|حليمة]] came from the desert into [[Makkah|مَكَّة]], she came very slowly because her donkey was so weak and slow.
Now going back from [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] to the desert on that same donkey with [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, that donkey is going faster than any of the other animals
from the other people who were in [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] who were going back as well. Now [[Halimah|حليمة]]'s donkey is getting ahead of all of them.
Such to the extent that they asked her: 'Is this the same animal that you came in on?'
And she said: 'Yes, it's the same one.' And then they said: '[[Wallahi|والله]], there is something special about this. This is not normal.'
So that was the first sign of the [[barakah|بركة]], going from [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] back into the desert with such speed on this donkey that was previously so slow.
Also [[Halimah|حليمة]], who didn't have even enough milk to take care of her own son,
now that she has Muhammad ﷺ with her, she has more than enough milk to take care of her son and [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ and fill both of them up.
So these were the signs of the [[barakah|بركة]] of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ that came with him into that family, the family of [[Halimah al-Sa'diyyah|حليمة السعدية]].

So [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ grew up, he grew up in the desert with [[Halimah al-Sa'diyyah|حليمة السعدية]], and there were so many incidents and beautiful things that happened to him while he was there.
And [[insha'Allah|إن شاء الله]] we will talk about those incidents in our next session [[bi-idhnillah|بإذن الله]] next week.

translit: Wallāhu aʿlam. Wa ṣallallāhu wa sallama wa bāraka ʿalā nabiyyinā Muḥammad wa ʿalā ālihi wa ṣaḥbihi ajmaʿīn.
